corners.about: captures in alternatives, a prototype and meta scopes
corners.grammar:
name: Corners
scope: source.corners
contexts:
  prototype:
    - match: '#.*'
      scope: comment.line
  main:
    - match: '(?:(let)|(var))\s+(\w+)'
      captures:
        1: keyword.let
        2: storage.type.var
        3: variable.parameter
    - match: '"'
      push: string
  string:
    - meta_scope: string.quoted
    - meta_content_scope: meta.inside
    - match: '\\.'
      scope: constant.character.escape
    - match: '"'
      pop: true

corners.about: (?i), (?x), \b and . on non-ASCII, $ before the break, set and anonymous contexts
corners.grammar:
name: Flags
scope: source.flags
variables:
  id: '[a-z_]\w*'
  call: '{{id}}(?=\()'
contexts:
  main:
    - match: '(?i)\bselect\b'
      scope: keyword.sql
    - match: |
        (?x)
        \b (end) \s* \# \s* (\d+) # trailing
      captures:
        1: keyword.end
        2: constant.numeric
    - match: '{{call}}'
      scope: variable.function
    - match: '\w+$'
      scope: entity.name.type
    - match: '<'
      set:
        - meta_scope: entity.name.tag
        - match: '>'
          set: main
    - match: '(?<=:)\d'
      scope: constant.numeric
    - match: '.\.'
      scope: keyword.operator

corners.about: empty matches that push and pop, and a line too long
corners.grammar:
name: Empty
scope: source.empty
contexts:
  main:
    - match: '(?=[A-Z])'
      push: upper
    - match: '\d+'
      scope: constant.numeric
  upper:
    - match: '[A-Z]+'
      scope: support.type
    - match: '(?=[^A-Z])'
      pop: true

corners.about: a zero-width match never falls between the halves of a 😀
corners.grammar:
name: Pairs
scope: source.pairs
contexts:
  main:
    - match: '"'
      push: string
    - match: '(?<=😀)'
      push: after
  string:
    - meta_scope: string.quoted
    - match: '"|$'
      pop: true
  after:
    - match: '\w+'
      scope: keyword
      pop: true

corners.about: a lookbehind of one fixed width with lookarounds and \b inside it (obf-1037)
corners.grammar:
name: Behind
scope: source.behind
contexts:
  main:
    - match: '(?<=\b[a-z])\d+'
      scope: constant.numeric
    - match: '(?<=(?!q)[a-z]{2})!'
      scope: keyword
    - match: '(?<!(?<=x)y)z'
      scope: string
    - match: '(?<=ab|cd)e'
      scope: entity.name.function
